integrity: Self-contained analytic proof and independent finite numerical checker. Finite tests supplement, but cannot certify, the all-parameter theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only unnormalized symmetric two-sided exponentials at unit-translation integer modulation redundancy q>=2; no noninteger lattice assertions.
The qualitative frame property was already known; the claimed difference is exact sharp lower and upper bounds, extremal Zak locations, and a limiting condition number.
Full text of A.J.E.M. Janssen (1996), a potentially overlapping integer-oversampling frame-bound paper, was not obtainable; prior coverage by that source remains unresolved.
No independent mathematical audit, expert examination or publication-priority certification has been performed.
title: Sharp frame bounds for two-sided exponential Gabor systems at every integer oversampling
